items.summary: Recommendation: reject the candidate plan's new dispatches, including the dumbsluts.com preview, and maintain financial containment. Continue only the existing period-aligned revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation; do not approve new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 cannot be assigned to a site; reported site-attributed income of $0 does not prove zero performance. AI usage covers 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28: 4,926 calls, 228 errors, 5 transient errors, and $901.90 cost. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing/experiment costs are incomplete, monthly budget ceilings are blank, and no learning-outcome threshold exists. The 70 treatment outputs versus 44 controls are operational activity only; the evaluation is empty, with 58 versus 40 requests and 12.21 versus 9.39 average cycle hours. Minimum evidence before reconsidering growth: same-period site/content/tracking-ID revenue reconciliation; complete AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment cost ledger; approved budget ceilings; and a defined learning outcome with a maximum cost-to-learn. Retain existing reconciliation and containment work without duplicate telemetry.
